mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_session (id, user_id, title, message_count, last_intent, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, 0, #{lastIntent}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_intent = VALUES(last_intent), updated_at = NOW(), title = IF(agent_session.title IS NULL OR agent_session.title = '', VALUES(title), agent_session.title)
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_session SET message_count = message_count + #{delta}, last_intent = #{lastIntent}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_log (session_id, user_id, turn, user_input, intent, slots, tools_used, response_payload, reply, success, error_msg, cost_ms, created_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{turn}, #{userInput}, #{intent}, #{slots}, #{toolsUsed}, #{responsePayload}, #{reply}, #{success}, #{errorMsg}, #{costMs}, NOW())

INSERT INTO agent_log (session_id, user_id, turn, user_input, intent, slots, tools_used, reply, success, error_msg, cost_ms, created_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{turn}, #{userInput}, #{intent}, #{slots}, #{toolsUsed}, #{reply}, #{success}, #{errorMsg}, #{costMs}, NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.title, s.message_count, s.last_intent, s.updated_at, l.reply AS last_message FROM agent_session s LEFT JOIN agent_log l ON l.id = ( SELECT al.id FROM agent_log al WHERE al.session_id = s.id ORDER BY al.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
